summary: the reference circuit of the fuzzy_link encoding (UE) expressed through the Builder; every angle is a linear function of spec.alpha / spec.beta.
the reference circuit after the deterministic polish passes.

pair-Bell frame cx(q1,q3) cx(q2,q4) h(q1) h(q2) (2 CX each side) around a BFS-optimal 9-CX I->I parity network carrying the 10 Z-string phases as rz(-alpha/4) (6 K1 strings) and rz(-2 kappa2) (4 K2 strings); 13 CX, 10 rotations.

frame and parity network fused into one 12-CX Clifford path found by meet-in-the-middle BFS over 4-qubit Clifford cosets modulo single-qubit Cliffords (each qubit = one hyperbolic plane of Paulis); the 10 commuting Pauli rotations (6 at +-alpha/4, 4 at +-2 kappa2) are applied whenever a plane contains a target Pauli; 12 CX, 10 rotations.
